visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a woman crying with reddened eyes and a distraught facial expression, standing in an airport environment. Captions in Chinese describe a manager failing to board a plane. (2) Scene transitions to a black-and-white montage of the woman walking through an airport concourse with a large suitcase, followed by a close-up of her shouting with frustration, accompanied by animated purple lightning effects. (3) The woman is now in an indoor setting, sitting on a grey couch, wearing a black tank top. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy and frequent hand gestures, explaining a situation. (4) Graphic overlays appear, showing flight routes between Poland, Turkey, and Taiwan, along with the Turkish Airlines logo and checkmark/cross symbols indicating seat availability. (5) A montage follows showing various snippets: a 'Denied Boarding' document from Turkish Airlines, people waiting in an airport, and a comparison graphic detailing compensation benefits like 600 Euros and free hotel stays. (6) The video includes a humorous segment where the woman's face is superimposed over characters from a dramatic anime. (7) POV-style footage shows the woman interacting with airport staff, holding a passport, and receiving cash. (8) Shots of a hotel room with two beds and a TV, followed by a white shuttle van parked outside an airport at sunset. (9) Final shot returns to the woman on the couch, summarizing her advice with a cheerful expression.

(2) A sharp 'whoosh' and thunder impact SFX trigger a transition to shouting and chaotic vocal effects. (3) The main narration begins: a clear, energetic female voice speaking Chinese at a fast rate. Upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic guitar and light percussion BGM starts. (4) Frequent 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the appearances of text and graphics. (5) In the middle section, a dramatic orchestral BGM swell and shouting voices from an anime clip interrupt the main flow for comedic effect. (6) In the airport POV phase, muffled ambient chatter and the mechanical rustling of a suitcase and cash are heard under the narration. (7) Final phase features a concluding, friendly vocal tone with the upbeat BGM fading into a hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Crisis Identification -> Educational Breakdown -> Anecdote -> Tips/Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal travel vlog documenting the creator's experience with airline overbooking. It serves both as a humorous storytelling piece about travel mishaps and an informative guide explaining the compensation rights and processes of Turkish Airlines, advising viewers on how to handle similar situations.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high editing density and meme-style visual/audio elements to maintain high engagement while delivering informative content about air travel rights.
